_comment: Ceiling floors under score.py SCORER_VERSION 2 (strict: a site matches only when symbol AND file agree; a same-named symbol in another file is a false positive, a pathless one is weak evidence). Re-measured 2026-09-06 against prism main 8a95848 / grove v0.43.1 on the pinned corpora. The engine output is IDENTICAL to what the previous floors (grove v0.30.0 / prism v0.42.0, 2026-08-10) were measured on — verified by rerunning the old scorer on the same binaries — so every number that moved here moved because the scorer stopped excusing name-only matches: precision floors fall where change-impact lists same-named overrides/callers in files the PR did not touch (jackson-serialize 0.9908 -> 0.8640, grafana-120119 0.9375 -> 0.7143), and two recall floors fall where the engine found the NAME in another file but not the ground-truth site (guava 0.9968 -> 0.9839, jackson-writetypeprefix 1.0 -> 0.9737 — real misses the lenient scorer hid). ci_site_diff.py lists the exact sites. A run scoring below (baseline - tolerance) on any corpus is a regression: either an engine defect reintroduced, or a genuine improvement that should update this file deliberately, not silently. ci_invariants refuses to run when scorer_version does not match score.py. Scorer v3 (weak pathless/bare-basename answers now cost precision) leaves every floor unchanged: engine sites always carry a path, so no weak match can occur here — re-verified by a full run.
